# Reset Player Hero Availability

Source: [wiki article 4403](../archive/4403.md); edited 2024-11-26.

Exact pinned API: [Reset Player Hero Availability](../../api/actions/reset-player-hero-availability.md).

<a id="wiki-4403-n1"></a>

- Reset Player Hero Availability restores lobby settings; if current hero becomes unavailable, player must choose another and respawn at an appropriate spawn location.
